purpose: Chain a verified Streamline 2.14.1 CreateSwapChain interposer already owning System32 DXGI factory slot 10, then observe the raw lower swap beneath ReShade.

original.validation: Exact ReShade wrapper and System32 DXGI identities, current slot pointer, method-owner module hash/size/image/prologue and RVA must all match. Unknown hooks are not replaced.

replacement.representation: Atomic compare/exchange of the DXGI factory vtable pointer with a process-lifetime callback. No code or disk bytes are modified.

abi.behavior: Call the exact saved Streamline method once and preserve its HRESULT/output. Observe the selected raw swap read-only. The current build does not initialize Streamline or enable FG in Skyrim.

lifetime.installation: Inside the verified ReShade factory callback before its downstream CreateSwapChain call.
lifetime.ownership: Pin RazKolbas, System32 DXGI and the Streamline method module; retain the saved method in a process-lifetime lease.
lifetime.removal: No hot removal while callback execution is possible; process exit removes it.

recovery.disable: Add streamline2141.factory.create-native-lower-chain-v1 to Patching.DisabledPatchIds and restart Skyrim.
recovery.failure_scope: Any identity or pointer mismatch leaves the existing chain untouched; the outer ReShade factory call continues.

evidence: Separate-process probe loaded the exact installed ReShade 6.8 wrapper and Streamline 2.14.1, observed native DXGI factory slot 10 owned by sl.interposer.dll RVA 0x26510, then chained it below ReShade.
Capstone 5 decoded exact-hash method 0x26510, including a downstream call with the original four CreateSwapChain arguments.
Focused standalone ReShade facade probe reported two actual presentations for eight FG-On submissions and completion fence values 1 through 8; no Skyrim FG-On result exists.
